vo: Getting a website for your business? The five-thousand-rupee website usually ends up costing you the most.
Five thousand or twenty-five thousand, they look exactly the same. But inside, there are five big differences.
One: design. The cheap one is a template shared by thousands of sites. The right one is designed for your business.
Two: domain. Cheap sites are often registered in the developer's name. The right one is in your name, and you're in control.
Three: speed. Cheap hosting means a slow site, and customers don't wait. The right one runs on fast hosting and opens in a blink.
Four: Google. Without SEO, Google doesn't even know you exist. Set it up right, and when customers search, they find you.
Five: leads. The cheap one is just an online brochure. The right one has a WhatsApp button and an inquiry form. Real leads.
A cheap website is an expense. The right website is an investment. One order, and it has paid for itself.
So don't just compare prices. Ask these five questions. Want a free check of your website? Comment, WEBSITE. And follow Softnear.
